kai: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need firm owners and finish dates for GPU capacity + autoscale fixes. Keep it tight.
anya: I'll drive the quota backstop and automate the emergency headroom toggle. Target: 2026-04-10.
ben: I'll handle scheduler tuning and the canary rollout. Plan: small-step canary, monitor tail latency, then widen. PR by 2026-04-08.
kai: Proposed list:
- ANYA: quota backstop + headroom toggle -> ticket + automation by 2026-04-10
- BEN: scheduler preemption & canary -> PR + telemetry by 2026-04-08
- KAI: runbook + rollback checklist -> update by 2026-04-09
ops-bot: Note: quota-ticket #812 created by anya. <https://issues.redwood/internal/812|#812>
anya: Added thresholds: headroom target 10-14% (depends on pool). Will include per-pool settings.
ben: Canary steps: 1% x 2h -> 5% x 6h -> 20% x 24h. Rollback command included in PR.
kai: Constraint: no kernel restarts outside maintenance windows. Call out legacy hosts in runbook.
ops-bot: Maintenance window reserved 2026-04-11 01:00-04:00 UTC.
anya: I'll attach test plan to ticket #812 and list monitoring alerts.
ben: I'll post the canary schedule in #eng-releases and tag oncall.
kai: Great. Please update the shared follow-up doc. Mid-week check-in scheduled Wed standup.
anya: ack.
ben: ack.
